title: How should process exhaust be removed from a cylinder curing oven?
summary: Suneng's 2020 curing-furnace documents for fully carbon-fibre-wrapped gas cylinders separately describe combustion-flue-gas heat exchange, internal hot-air circulation and furnace exhaust. The stated 15–20 cycles per minute refers to hot-air recirculation, not fresh-air changes or exhaust capacity. Identify each airflow and outlet before checking the configuration against resin emissions, loading and site exhaust connections.
